verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an integrations section with dedicated pages for AWS (cloud, via an AssumeRole role you can delete), GitHub (code hosting, without repository-content access) and Google Workspace (identity). Device posture comes from Oneleet's own first-party MDM rather than a connector to an existing MDM. HR and ticketing integrations are not evidenced, and read-only scoping is only implied (no repo-content access, an assumable role) rather than explicitly documented. Missing for 10: HR system integrations, ticketing integrations, third-party MDM connectors, explicit read-only scope documentation, a browsable catalog breadth beyond three connectors, independent corroboration.
